title: Codegeist 2026
description: Atlassian's annual online hackathon on Devpost. Build an app on Atlassian's Forge platform that integrates with at least one Atlassian product or capability (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, Teamwork Graph, Rovo), in one of three categories. $120,000 in cash prizes.
reward: $120,000 in prizes, paid in cash: three $15,000 first places, three $8,000 second places, three $5,000 third places, and 24 bonus prizes of $1,500
summary: $120,000 in prizes · closes Dec 22, 12:00 PM PT

rules: Submit on Devpost by Tuesday, December 22, 2026 at 12:00 PM Pacific Time.
Build an app on Atlassian's Forge platform that integrates with at least one of Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, Teamwork Graph or Rovo.
Categories: Apps for Software Teams, Apps for Business Teams, Apps for Specialized Industries.

Projects must be newly created and not published before the Submission Period, or, if they existed before, updated or rebuilt in Forge after it started, with a Forge manifest file and at least one Forge module.
Projects developed with funding, contracts or commercial licenses from Atlassian or Devpost are not eligible.
Bonus prizes of $1,500 (6 winners each): Best Agents (Rovo), Best app with Atlassian MCP, Best apps with Teamwork Graph integration, Best Marketplace published app.
Entrants must be above the legal age of majority; residents of Brazil, Quebec, Russia, Belarus, Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Sudan and Myanmar are excluded.
Judged equally on technological implementation, design, potential impact, innovation and presentation. Winners are announced on or around February 15, 2027.
